data.name: Jude
data.long_meaning: Jude means 'Jew'. It is a name used in the New Testament for one of the brothers of Jesus and a leader in the early Christian community.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of faith and connection to the Jewish roots of Christianity.

in_hebrew.name: יהודה
in_hebrew.meaning: יהודה הוא שם שפירושו 'הוא אשר משבח' או 'הוא אשר מודה'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יהודה הוא שם עברי שמקורו בשם העברי 'יהודה', שפירושו 'הוא אשר משבח' או 'הוא אשר מודה'. השם יהודה היה שמו של אחד משנים עשר בניו של יעקב, והוא גם שמו של שבט ישראל שנקרא על שמו. השם יהודה מוזכר לראשונה בתנוך, בספר בראשית, ומאוחר יותר הוא הפך לשם נפוץ בקרב היהודים והנוצרים.

in_greek.name: Ιούδας
in_greek.meaning: Ιούδας σημαίνει 'εκ του Θεού επαίνεσις' ή 'ο δοξάζων'
in_greek.long_meaning: Ιούδας είναι το ελληνικό ισοδύναμο του εβραϊκού ονόματος 'יהודה' (Yehudah), που σημαίνει 'εκ του Θεού επαίνεσις' ή 'ο δοξάζων'. Το όνομα Ιούδας αναφέρεται στον Ιούδα, έναν από τους δώδεκα αποστόλους του Ιησού Χριστού, όπως αναφέρεται στα Ευαγγέλια του Ματθαίου, του Μάρκου, του Λουκά και του Ιωάννη. Ο Ιούδας ήταν αυτός που παρέδωσε τον Ιησού στους Ρωμαίους, αλλά αργότερα έγινε σύμβολο για τη μετάνοια και τη συγχώρηση.

in_latin.name: Judas
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Judas derivatur ex hebraeo 'יהודה' (Yehudah), quod significat 'laus Dei' vel 'confessio'. In Ecclesia primitiva, Judas fuit nomen apostoli qui tradidit Iesum Christum, sed etiam postea factus est symbolum paenitentiae et remissionis. Nomen Judas in usu est inter Christianos et Catholicum et Orthodoxum et Protestantem.

in_english.name: Jude
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jude originates from the Hebrew 'יהודה' (Yehudah), meaning 'praised' or 'admired'. It is associated with Judas Iscariot, one of Jesus Christ's twelve apostles, who infamously betrayed Jesus. Despite this, the name Jude has been adopted by Christians as a symbol of redemption and forgiveness. Historically, Jude has been used in various Christian traditions and is often linked with Saint Jude Thaddeus, one of Jesus' twelve apostles, also known as Jude the Apostle.

biblical_reference.note: Jude is the Greek form of Judah, referring to one of Jesus' twelve apostles.

saint_reference.note: Saint Jude Thaddeus is one of Jesus Christ's twelve apostles and is often invoked in desperate situations.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jude holds cultural significance as it is derived from the Hebrew name Judah, which means 'praised' or 'glorified'. In the biblical context, Judah was one of the twelve tribes of Israel. Through the use of this name in the New Testament, Jude represents the connection of early Christianity to its Jewish roots.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jude holds deep spiritual significance due to its association with Jude, the biblical author and the brother of Jesus Christ. He is considered to be an important figure in early Christianity, helping to establish and strengthen the faith community. The name Jude, therefore, symbolizes the spiritual connection and commitment to the teachings of Jesus and the legacy he left behind. It also emphasizes the importance of unity and brotherhood within the Christian community.

historical_references.reference: Jude, a brother of Jesus, writes a letter to the elect, exhorting them to contend for the faith and resist false teachers.
historical_references.context: The New Testament book of Jude is believed to have been written by Jude, a brother of Jesus, as a warning against false teachers and their destructive heresies.

historical_references.reference: Jude was likely a leader in the early Christian community in Jerusalem and may have been a descendant of the tribe of Judah.
historical_references.context: The historical identity of Jude, the author of the New Testament book, is a subject of debate among scholars. Some believe he was a leader in the early Christian community in Jerusalem and a descendant of the tribe of Judah.

trends: Biblical references in literature and music
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jude is of Hebrew origin and means 'praised'. In modern context, it's seen on various platforms. In the literature and music industry, Jude is referenced biblically for inspiration and as a name for characters in songs and books. In the film and television industry, Jude Law is a renowned British actor known for his roles in films and television shows. In the fashion industry, Jude Reid is the founder of the sustainable fashion brand 'Jude'. These trends demonstrate the versatility and enduring appeal of the name Jude in contemporary society.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Jude, meaning "giver of thanks" or "Jew", represents gratitude and connection to the Jewish roots of Christianity. It is a reminder to always express gratitude and cherish our heritage.
